item.title: Police officer loses fight to cancer
item.description: Sophie Moore. Photo: supplied A Christchurch detective, who was raised in Gore, has died from a rare form of blood cancer, just days after marrying her "soulmate".

item.title: Call for ‘nitrate emergency’
item.description: Greenpeace are calling for a nitrate emergency to be declared in Southland.

item.title: Cows probable cause of spike: report
item.description: Photo: ODT files Cows were the likely cause of alarmingly high nitrate spikes in Gore’s drinking water supply last year, an Environment Southland report released last week indicates.

item.title: Tuned in for contest
item.description: PHOTO: GREGOR RICHARDSON Tuner Roger Kidd uses a phone to tune the bagpipes of Hokonui Celtic piper Jeff Shanks at the Otago-Southland Pipe Band Championships in Dunedin on Saturday.

item.title: Man now facing murder charge after woman's death
item.description: A 24-year-old man who previously faced lesser charges after a woman was found dead in a Kāpiti Coast house has now been charged with murder.
